title: RNA-Seq of CD19+ B-cell populations from patients with juvenile dermatomyositis and controls
description: RNA sequencing was used to compare the transcriptional state of ex-vivo B-cells from children with Juvenile dermatomyositis (JDM) pre- and on-treatment and age-matched healthy controls. RNA was extracted from blood samples that were taken from juvenile dermatomyositis patients at diagnosis (before they received treatment) and approximately a year into treatment. The treatment included oral prednisolone, methotrexate, azathioprine, cyclophosphamide and other drugs.

samples.title: JDM-RN-18-1132-MR
samples.description: Protocols: CD19+ B cells were sorted from freeze-thawed peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) by flow cytometry (FACS Aria III), using CD19 PE-Cy7 (BioLegend). DAPI was used to exclude dead cells. Sorted B cell RNA was extracted using the Arcturus PicoPure RNA Isolation Kit. Samples were processed using Illumina’s TruSeq Stranded mRNA LT sample preparation kit (p/n RS-122-2101) according to manufacturer’s instructions.

runs.experiment_title: NextSeq 500 paired end sequencing: RNA-Seq of CD19+ B-cell populations from patients with juvenile dermatomyositis and controls
